decisions.reason: Although this particle-therapy water phantom remains the most vulnerable because of its niche scope and earlier rollout limitations, management is still likely to continue supporting it given the sunk development effort, the public launch commitment, and its fit with the firm's high-precision dosimetry image.

As a specialist ionization chamber embedded in the firm's established measurement portfolio, it is more likely to be retained because prior investment and responsibility make management inclined to interpret any weak traction as temporary rather than decisive.
This multi-model standard clinical chamber line represents a broad and visible commitment in a core category, so escalation of commitment strongly favors continued support over withdrawal.

Because the relative dosimetry chamber helps complete the firm's QA offering and supports cross-selling into existing clinical accounts, management is likely to justify keeping it despite any middling standalone performance.

A thimble ionization chamber is a conventional, core-adjacent product for this kind of German medical physics supplier, making near-term withdrawal unlikely given accumulated launch costs and portfolio logic.
